MicroVoice browser build uses the software and assets credited below.

ONNX Runtime Web 1.25.1 (MIT)
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.25.1

Echogarden eSpeak NG Emscripten 0.3.5 (GPL-3.0)
https://github.com/echogarden-project/espeak-ng-emscripten
Source and build instructions are in the upstream repository. The eSpeak NG
source used by the port is at https://github.com/echogarden-project/espeak-ng.

Pipedog eSpeak NG adapter 0.11.0 (BSD-2-Clause)
https://github.com/polvallverdu/pipedog/tree/main/packages/espeak-ng

XZ-Decompress 0.2.3 (MIT)
https://github.com/httptoolkit/xz-decompress

Kuromoji.js 0.1.2 (Apache-2.0) and its IPADIC dictionary
https://github.com/takuyaa/kuromoji.js
The dictionary and third-party notices are included in Kuromoji-NOTICE.md.

The Kitten TTS 2 Mini and Mandarin HuaYan checkpoints are bundled with their
original weights. See the model notice files for model-specific attribution.
